title: Degreewise pseudo-coherence of a derived complex on a scheme
statement: Let $Y$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $m\in\mathbf Z$, and let $L\in D(\mathcal O_Y)$ [def-pc-derived-category]. Say that $L$ is $m$-pseudo-coherent if there exist an open covering $Y=\bigcup_{c\in C}W_c$ and, for each $c$, a strictly perfect complex $P_c^\bullet$ of $\mathcal O_{W_c}$-modules [def-pc-perfect-complex] and a morphism $\alpha_c:P_c^\bullet\to L|_{W_c}$ in $D(\mathcal O_{W_c})$, where $W_c$ is the open subscheme and $L|_{W_c}=Lj_c^*L$ is the derived pullback [def-pc-derived-pullback] along the inclusion $j_c:W_c\to Y$, such that $H^j(\alpha_c)$ is an isomorphism for every $j>m$ and $H^m(\alpha_c)$ is surjective. Here $P_c^\bullet$ in the displayed morphism means its image in the derived category, and $H^j$ denotes the cohomology-sheaf functor. The covering and the strictly perfect approximations may depend on $m$.
